notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting' (8): My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal, Begin Landing Your Troops, Start Your Engines!, Sebulba's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Tatooine: Desert Landing Site and Coruscant: Galactic Senate; these count toward the 60.

The title calls it a 'Type II' deck and the strategy a 'Closed Environment' deck (Episode I-only environment); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set Dark printings are used for Control and Coruscant: Docking Bay.

Earlier version of the same author's 'ONE-ARM's Type II Senators of DEATH Part2' (DeckTech 19189, 2 October 2001), which adds Watto's Box (started instead of Begin Landing Your Troops) and the Sense/Alter package; this list runs Begin Landing Your Troops as the starting effect, Aks Moe, Gardulla The Hutt, Nute Gunray, a second Edcel Bar Gane and a second P-60, Our Blockade Is Perfectly Legal, Accepting Trade Federation Control, On The Payroll Of The Trade Federation and three extra sites (Blockade Flagship: Bridge, Coruscant: Docking Bay, Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay).

The starting section uses joke names, dested as in 19189: 'My, Lord Is That Legal?/If it is, I'll plead Insanity.' the Objective; 'Daytona 500' the Dark Boonta Eve Podrace and 'Tatooine RacePlace' the Dark Tatooine: Podrace Arena (both deployed by Start Your Engines!); 'TAtooine Maul's Hutt' Tatooine: Desert Landing Site and 'Senator Death Chamber' the Dark Coruscant: Galactic Senate (the Objective's two starting locations).
